藏品名称_EN: millie the echidna (mcdonalds happy meal toy)
藏品名称_ZN: 针鼹鼠米莉（麦当劳快乐餐玩具）
描述_EN: the sydney olympic games 2000 had three mascots of which millie the echidna (spiny anteater) was one the other two were olly the kookaburra and syd the platypus. the first olympic mascot 'waldi' a daschund dog appeared at the 1972 munich olympic games. mascots are used to communicate the olympic spirit to the general public, especially youth and children. the mascots were commercialised in a range of products, toys and the partnership with mcdonalds. olly, the kookaburra epitomises the olympic spirit of generosity, millie an echidna is a techno-whiz and syd the platypus reflects the environment and captures the vigour and energy of australia and its people. they were designed by matthew hattan and their purpose was clearly outlined by the sydney organising committee of the olympic games (socog). they are usually a character or animal native to the country where the games are being held and showcase the history and culture unique to the host city. it stated 'syd, millie and olly's role [was] to communicate the ideals of the sydney 2000 olympic games… their mission [was] to inspire, entertain, inform and embrace'. together, syd, olly and millie represent earth, air and water. this could be to ensure gender equity but has undoubtedly increased the merchandising potential of the olympic mascot. in more recent years it has been common to have more than one mascot.
描述_ZN: 2000年悉尼奥运会有三个吉祥物，其中针鼹鼠Millie是其中之一，另外两个是袋鼠Olly和鸭嘴兽Syd。 第一个奥运吉祥物 "Waldi "是一只达斯康德犬，出现在1972年的慕尼黑奥运会上。 吉祥物被用来向公众，特别是青少年和儿童传达奥林匹克精神。 吉祥物在一系列产品、玩具以及与麦当劳的合作中被商业化。 年，Kookaburra是慷慨的奥林匹克精神的缩影，Millie是一个技术天才，鸭嘴兽Syd反映了环境并捕捉到了澳大利亚和其人民的活力和能量。 它们是由Matthew Hattan设计的，它们的目的由悉尼奥运会组织委员会（Socog）明确列出。 它们通常是奥运会举办地国家的本土人物或动物，展示主办城市特有的历史和文化。 它说 "Syd、Millie和Oly的作用是传达悉尼2000年奥运会的理想......他们的任务是激励、娱乐、宣传和拥抱"。 在一起，Syd、Oly和Millie代表地球、空气和水。 这可能是为了确保性别平等，但无疑也增加了奥运吉祥物的商业潜力。 最近几年，拥有一个以上的吉祥物是很常见的。
